r19c-001.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning. | whereas

item.q: Choose the correct option: My partner loves late nights, ___ I'm at my best early in the morning.
item.why: All four words show a contrast, but only *whereas* (or *while*) joins two facts with a comma in the middle: *…, whereas I'm at my best early.* *however* and *nevertheless* start a new sentence or come after a semicolon (*…late nights; however, I'm…*); *despite* needs a noun or *-ing* (*despite loving late nights*).
item.why_lv: Visi četri vārdi izsaka pretstatu, bet tikai *whereas* (vai *while*) ar komatu teikuma vidū savieno divus faktus: *…, whereas I'm at my best early.* *however* un *nevertheless* sāk jaunu teikumu vai stāv aiz semikola (*…late nights; however, I'm…*); aiz *despite* vajag lietvārdu vai *-ing* (*despite loving late nights*).
